name: atlas-lms
description: Atlas LMS multi-tenant white-label learning platform

scripts.ci: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:route-metadata && pnpm check:prisma-boundary && pnpm check:audit-compliance && pnpm check:outbox-compliance && pnpm check:forbidden-scope && pnpm check:secrets && pnpm db:migrate:check && pnpm db:rls:check && pnpm build
scripts.precommit: pnpm check:env && pnpm exec lint-staged && pnpm typecheck
scripts.prepush: pnpm test:unit && pnpm check:route-metadata && pnpm check:prisma-boundary
scripts.db:migrate:check: echo "Migration validation is not configured yet. This will be implemented in Sprint 0."
scripts.db:rls:check: echo "RLS validation is not configured yet. This will be implemented in Sprint 0."
